title: Strait of Hormuz traffic fell and mariners were evacuated, but durable closure remains unproven
summary: U.S. claims of degrading Iran’s ability to attack shipping align with evidence of reduced tanker traffic and AIS, the ships’ broadcast tracking data used by other vessels and traffic managers, shutdowns, while IMO evacuation planning suggests security pressure rather than a verified, sustained blockade.
